description: Finishes a dispatched worker's ticket when its session stops, and only when the worker touched its done file: commit what is left onto the branch, push it, open the branch's pull request or reuse the one already on it, write that url onto the ticket's `pr` metadata, then close the ticket. The plan's `branch` key is never written back. A session that died on an API error instead parks its ticket in failed-agent with the reason appended. Sessions the dispatcher did not spawn exit on either hook's first line.
